prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1256; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is regarding the collision you were involved in while driving in Houston, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your current address and phone number for the record.

A: I'd rather keep my address private for now, but you can reach me through the number on file with my policy.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened in the moments before the collision?

A: I was in the center lane on a busy road, and I signaled to move into the right lane because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror and it looked clear, so I started to merge.

Q: Did you check your blind spot before changing lanes?

A: I glanced over my shoulder, but I think I was focused on the exit sign and didn't turn my head fully.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other car was in my blind spot. It came up beside me and we sideswiped each other. My car pushed to the right and I grabbed the steering wheel hard to get control.

Q: Where did you feel the injury?

A: My left wrist. I braced against the wheel and felt a sharp pain right away. I couldn't move my fingers comfortably, so I went to urgent care afterward.

Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle on your own?

A: Yes, I got out and sat on the curb until the officer arrived. He took my statement and gave me a report number.

Q: Did you see the other driver's speed or lane position before impact?

A: Not really. It all happened quickly. I only noticed the car when it was already next to me.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my car and my medical bills taken care of.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
